title: Block Replacer
description: Replace blocks around you in real-time using a simple in-game menu.
body:
BlockReplacerMod lets you dynamically replace blocks around the player while playing.

Using a simple in-game menu (press K), you can choose:
- Which block to replace
- What to replace it with
- The radius of the effect
- Whether the system is enabled

The mod works in real-time, meaning as you walk around, blocks within the selected radius will instantly transform.

Examples:
- Turn sand into gold blocks while walking on a beach
- Convert grass into stone to create paths
- Experiment with different block transformations easily

Features:
- Easy-to-use GUI
- Works without commands (but supports them)
- Remembers your last settings



Perfect for experimentation, building, or just having fun transforming the world around you.
